plan.title: Kids Improvement: Baseline to Endline
plan.subtitle: How performance metrics changed across locations and coaches

panels.title: Total Children Tracked
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM "baseline" UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM "endline"

panels.title: Avg Shuttle Run Improvement by Location
panels.sql: WITH baseline_agg AS (SELECT "Location", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS b_run FROM "baseline" GROUP BY 1), endline_agg AS (SELECT "Location", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS e_run FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1), combined AS (SELECT b."Location", b.b_run, e.e_run FROM baseline_agg b JOIN endline_agg e ON b."Location" = e."Location" WHERE b.b_run IS NOT NULL AND e.e_run IS NOT NULL) SELECT "Location", (b_run - e_run) AS improvement FROM combined ORDER BY improvement DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Avg Sit Ups Improvement by Coach
panels.sql: WITH baseline_agg AS (SELECT "Coach", AVG("Sit ups") AS b_sit FROM "baseline" GROUP BY 1), endline_agg AS (SELECT "Coach", AVG("Sit ups") AS e_sit FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1), combined AS (SELECT b."Coach", b.b_sit, e.e_sit FROM baseline_agg b JOIN endline_agg e ON b."Coach" = e."Coach" WHERE b.b_sit IS NOT NULL AND e.e_sit IS NOT NULL) SELECT "Coach", (e_sit - b_sit) AS improvement FROM combined ORDER BY improvement DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top 10 Locations by Weight Gain
panels.sql: WITH baseline_agg AS (SELECT "Location", AVG("Weight kg") AS b_w FROM "baseline" GROUP BY 1), endline_agg AS (SELECT "Location", AVG("Weight kg") AS e_w FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1), combined AS (SELECT b."Location", b.b_w, e.e_w FROM baseline_agg b JOIN endline_agg e ON b."Location" = e."Location" WHERE b.b_w IS NOT NULL AND e.e_w IS NOT NULL) SELECT "Location", (e_w - b_w) AS weight_gain FROM combined ORDER BY weight_gain DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Coaches by Height Gain
panels.sql: WITH baseline_agg AS (SELECT "Coach", AVG("Height cm") AS b_h FROM "baseline" GROUP BY 1), endline_agg AS (SELECT "Coach", AVG("Height cm") AS e_h FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1), combined AS (SELECT b."Coach", b.b_h, e.e_h FROM baseline_agg b JOIN endline_agg e ON b."Coach" = e."Coach" WHERE b.b_h IS NOT NULL AND e.e_h IS NOT NULL) SELECT "Coach", (e_h - b_h) AS height_gain FROM combined ORDER BY height_gain DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Locations by Sit Ups Gain
panels.sql: WITH baseline_agg AS (SELECT "Location", AVG("Sit ups") AS b_sit FROM "baseline" GROUP BY 1), endline_agg AS (SELECT "Location", AVG("Sit ups") AS e_sit FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1), combined AS (SELECT b."Location", b.b_sit, e.e_sit FROM baseline_agg b JOIN endline_agg e ON b."Location" = e."Location" WHERE b.b_sit IS NOT NULL AND e.e_sit IS NOT NULL) SELECT "Location", (e_sit - b_sit) AS sit_ups_gain FROM combined ORDER BY sit_ups_gain DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Coaches by Weight Gain
panels.sql: WITH baseline_agg AS (SELECT "Coach", AVG("Weight kg") AS b_w FROM "baseline" GROUP BY 1), endline_agg AS (SELECT "Coach", AVG("Weight kg") AS e_w FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1), combined AS (SELECT b."Coach", b.b_w, e.e_w FROM baseline_agg b JOIN endline_agg e ON b."Coach" = e."Coach" WHERE b.b_w IS NOT NULL AND e.e_w IS NOT NULL) SELECT "Coach", (e_w - b_w) AS weight_gain FROM combined ORDER BY weight_gain DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard tracks the physical development of children from baseline to endline measurements. The first panel shows the total number of unique children tracked across both time points. Subsequent bar charts highlight average improvements in shuttle run times, sit-ups, weight, and height, grouped by location and coach. These metrics help identify which groups saw the most significant gains in agility, strength, and growth. The final tables list the top 10 locations and coaches for specific metrics like weight gain and height gain, allowing for a detailed comparison of performance across different training environments.
